cohort: The study included 320 mother-infant dyads consecutively enrolled at Abobo Houphouet-Boigny Regional Hospital in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire.
finding: Higher maternal education increased the likelihood of EIBF, while cesarean delivery significantly reduced it compared with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery markedly reduced the likelihood of early initiation of breastfeeding compared with vaginal delivery (aOR = 0.08; 95% CI: 0.04-0.14; p < 0.001).
